name: QPS Holdings Inc.
summary: QPS Holdings Inc. researches, develops, designs, manufactures, sells, operates and maintains satellites and equipment mounted on them, precision and electronic equipment, software, communication networks and ground facilities. It also deals with data acquired by satellites, offers satellite-based services, and runs research meetings, workshops, seminars, contract work and education tied to the satellite business. Incorporated in 2025, it has its headquarters in Fukuoka City, Japan.
